visual_concept: 暖橘色圆润角色站在工作台前，左手举着一大叠厚纸（标“2000字”），右手举着一小张纸（标“200字”），表情惊喜。背景有工程流程图图标（循环箭头、数据库、评分星形），所有元素统一在暖奶油底色场景中。
image_prompt:
A FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION in classic editorial magazine cover art style. Ink and watercolor on textured paper, designed-not-rendered, with visible hand-drawn linework and intentional limited color palette. This is NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic concept-art image. Think the look of a printed editorial illustration on paper.

SUBJECT:
A warm orange round cartoon character (designer vinyl figure quality) standing at a wooden worktable. The character wears a simple cream-colored outfit, has large curious eyes, and a surprised/happy expression. In the left hand, the character holds up a thick stack of paper labeled "2000字" in Chinese; in the right hand, a single thin sheet labeled "200字". On the table behind the papers, there are simplified engineering workflow icons: a circular arrow (data loop), a database cylinder, and a star rating shape, all drawn in flat line art. The background is a warm cream wall with a subtle paper texture. The title text "别优化prompt了" is integrated as a large hand-lettered sign on the wall above the character.

CHARACTER:
- Round, friendly cartoon figure, warm orange (Hex #E8743B) body, cream white (Hex #FFF3E2) face and hands, big black eyes with white highlights, small smile.
- Interacting: left hand holding thick stack, right hand holding thin sheet, looking at the sheets with eyebrows raised in pleasant surprise.
- NOT wearing a fisherman hat, NOT wearing plaid shirt or logo hoodie, NOT techie stereotype.

STYLE (critical — must enforce):
- FLAT ILLUSTRATION, ink and watercolor style
- visible brush strokes, paper texture, hand-drawn linework
- matte finish, designed-not-rendered
- limited color palette with intentional negative space
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO cinematic rendering
- NO glossy plastic, NO chrome, NO 3D realism
- NO photographic depth-of-field, NO bokeh

LIGHTING & MOOD:
- Soft natural light, expressed through flat illustration with uniform color fields and no realistic shadows. Warm and inviting.
- NOT cinematic lighting, NOT realistic shadows.

COMPOSITION (the one principle: CANVAS UNITY):
- 2.35:1 horizontal aspect ratio = 47:20 (1920×816 default).
- The whole canvas is one designed object: the character, table, papers, icons, and title sign form a single cohesive scene. The title sign is visually connected to the wall behind the character, and the character's arms bridge the papers to the table. No element floats in isolation. The left side has the thick stack and character's left arm, the right side has thin sheet and character's right arm, and the center is the character's face and the title sign above. The engineering icons on the table create a visual base. Intentional negative space exists as the cream wall, which is not accidental blank but serves as breathing room around the central action.
- Every region has purpose: no forgotten corners, no dead spots. The papers are directly connected to the character's hands, the character is grounded on the table, the table fills the lower third, the wall fills the upper two-thirds with the title sign centered.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, with area proportions):
Brand: warm orange playful. Philosophy: bright friendliness, warm cream base with disciplined orange signature.
- Dominant background (warm cream / light apricot): Hex #FFF3E2 / #FDEAD0 — ≥50% of image area (wall, table surface).
- Brand signature (warm orange): Hex #E8743B — 15-25% (character body, title text outline, thick stack edge).
- Secondary (amber yellow): Hex #F2B23E — 10-15% (thin sheet, star icon, secondary accent).
- Emphasis (brick red): Hex #C8472B — 5-10% (only used for the "2000字" label and "200字" label, and a small accent on the character's cheeks).
- Ignition (duck green): Hex #2A9D8F — ≤5% (only used for the character's iris center — a single spark of cool contrast).
- NO pure black (#000000), NO pure white (#FFFFFF), NO rainbow gradients, NO neon.

TEXT IN IMAGE:
- main title: "别优化prompt了" — Chinese, in 霞鹜文楷 style (warm rounded humanist serif), large and dominant, occupying ≥40% of visual weight. Color: warm orange (Hex #E8743B) with a thin dark outline for readability against the cream wall.
- No subtitle text.
- No corner small text.

NEGATIVE:
- NO abstract neural network diagrams
- NO glowing brain or digital head
- NO robot-human handshake
- NO circuit board background
- NO data stream / particle flows
- NO gradient geometric shapes
- NO VR goggles, NO AR headsets
- NO holographic UI floating in air
- NO futuristic city skyline
- NO chrome/metallic AI face
- NO binary code rain
- NO glossy plastic finish
- NO real-world brand logos or trademarks
- NO photographic realism, NO cinematic concept art
- NO programmer stereotypes (no plaid shirts, no logo hoodies, no VR gear)
